title: Bitwise Bouncer
description: can_enter(age, has_ticket) should return True only for people aged 18 or more who have a ticket. Somehow everyone gets in.
code:
def can_enter(age, has_ticket):
    return age >= 18 & has_ticket
solution:
def can_enter(age, has_ticket):
    return age >= 18 and has_ticket
hint: `&` is not the same as `and`. Which happens first: `>=` or `&`?
explanation: `&` is the bitwise AND operator, and it binds tighter than `>=`. The code computes `age >= (18 & has_ticket)`. `18 & True` and `18 & False` are both 0, so it's always `age >= 0`. Use the logical operator `and`.
